item.title: Can you spot a fake bank note?
item.description: Lincolnshire Police say.. At first glance they can look pretty convincing. We are seeing an increase in counterfeit notes, especially £20s, across the county. There are reports of these being used in payment for goods sold on local selling sites like Facebook Marketplace – but they could pop up anywhere. item.title: Home Office funding offers “stability and optimism” for local police force
item.description: Lincolnshire Police has been offered a funding package that will allow the Force to avoid widespread staff and officer reductions and to provide a level of policing that will keep the county safe. item.title: Lincolnshire Police to hold four-week firearms amnesty
item.description: The amnesty will take place between 2 February and 27 February 2026 for five types of BRUNI-manufactured top-venting blank firers (TVBFs), after which anyone in possession of one the specified TVBFs could be subject to prosecution and up to 10 years imprisonment.
